$Comment: Martha's Favor: the name, picture and payouts of the game's reputation group of the same id
(NPC/Reputation/Groups/Harvest_Feast_Host.json), which keeps each player's number. Players read the
name from reputation.harvest_feast_host.name; never rename the id, since every player's favor is
filed under it.
Ranks renames the library's ranks for Martha alone; a rank left out keeps the library's name, and a
lock on one of these ranks reads the name written here. The ids stay the library's (Honored is the
rank Martha calls Friend). Order places her on the Reputation page after Old Jack and the Hallowed.
Favor comes from the Reputation rewards on her quests and board jobs, from her daily greeting, and
from Kills: Amount favor for each creature put down whose role is in one of the listed NPC groups,
here Harvest_Feast_Turkeys (NPC/Groups), the feast's Wild Turkeys. The Harvest Set raises every gain
of this favor by a percent while worn, through the stat ReputationGain_Harvest_Feast_Host
(Entity/Stats), which the library finds by this file's id; gear that raises the library's global
ReputationGain still does too.
With no Cap, favor keeps climbing past Exalted (Head of the Table), and each time earned favor passes
another multiple of Every above Exalted's floor, Beyond's Rewards wait for the player to collect them
on the Reputation page: here the loot table Harvest_Feast_Feast_Basket. Earn lists the ways to earn
favor, one lang key a line, for the How to earn block on the Reputation page.
The ranks open things up: Friendly (Neighbor) the Harvest Salad recipe, the Harvest Gloves and a second
Field job, Honored (Friend) the Harvest Hat and a second Kitchen job, Revered (Family) the Martha's Roast
recipe and the Harvest Trousers, and Exalted (Head of the Table) the Harvest Tunic. Each rank also has
an achievement that pays a gift: harvest_feast_marthas_neighbor, _marthas_friend, _marthas_family and
harvest_feast_head_of_the_table, which also pays its title.
